input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Neither the term/termination provisions (Sections 13-14) nor the confidentiality section contains any post-termination transition assistance, data export/return or deletion mechanic. Section 13 only places burdens on us (arranging a new name server within 30 days and a new hosting environment within 60 days) and confirms domain ownership; Section 10 has no return-or-destroy obligation at all, and in any event confidentiality return is not transition help. With no data return obligation this sits in walk-away territory, so we insert a single transition clause at the preferred level: six months' assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable return within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion after return. 90 days' assistance with a 30-day export would be an acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data return obligations after Section 14 (Termination).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The agreement gives us no exit rights, so we added an orderly transition and data return provision: up to six months of assistance at TrueLink's then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion after return. We can accept 90 days of assistance and a 30-day export as a fallback.

ops.text: TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF DATA. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, return to Client all Client Content and other Client data in TrueLink's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after such return, delete such Client Content and data from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
